name: Chef's Van
detailed_description:
Welcome to 'Chef's Van'

In this healing adventure game that combines culinary management, light Rogue, and multiplayer collaboration, you will become a free roaming foodie, driving an exclusive RV stationed at a coastal campsite, receiving cooking orders from around the world, and embarking on a journey to conquer the world with food! Whether enjoying a slow life alone or teaming up with friends to cook, this place can satisfy all your fantasies of rural adventure!

Game features:

🍳 Open Cooking Adventure

Starting from the open-air campsite in Yuyu Town, accept food commissions from all over the world, earn coins with cooking, upgrade your kitchen equipment and RV cabin!

🚐 RV Life x Free Exploration

Your RV is not only a mobile kitchen, but also a cozy little home! Customize interior style and add camping equipment! Driving through mountains, rivers, lakes, and seas during the day, returning to the campsite at night to chat with the townspeople around the stove, experiencing the romance of "four seas as home".

👫 1-4 person online collaboration

Call on friends to form a "kitchen team" and divide tasks to complete the order challenge! One person cuts vegetables, one person cooks, one person delivers meals... flustered and constantly laughing! You can also compete for cooking scores or compete at the town's food festival!

🏡 Small Town Adventure x Plot Secret

Yuyu Town is far more than just a task transfer station! Interacting with townspeople with diverse personalities, and so on! There are also hidden tasks!

🛍️ The store page is continuously being renovated······

Join 'Chef's Van' now and let the stomachs and hearts of the world cheer for you!

🎮 Join the wish list and embark on a delicious journey as soon as possible! ​  🎮

short_description: Travel the world in an RV, heal hearts with cuisine! In 'Chef's Van', manage your food truck in an idyllic seaside town, fulfill international orders, unlock authentic recipes, and team up for hilarious cooking challenges. Savor culinary freedom and friendship - whether solo or with friends!

  • Processor: 2.0GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Direct X 9.0c compliant video card with 512 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
